overall: Okay, honestly? I had fun, and I don't say that about quizzes. Chapter 2 and the money chapter are the strongest: the 11:48pm text with 'third night this week', the 'you're a disaster, then send it anyway' loan, 'ten minutes, left three hours later', and following the café staff to their new job are lines I'd screenshot for my group chat and my partner. Where it lost me is repetition, the same thing your first test hit: four bill-splitting cards (and 'Fair is fair' twice), two parents-helped-them head-start cards, three 'your friend shows you something bad, do you say so' cards in one chapter, two group-chat setups in chapter 1, two wedding cards two cards apart, and the lazy free afternoon twice with almost the same line. Small jokes repeat too: noodles twice, 'that money already has a job' three times, and 'pick the two that are the most you' word for word. The cool-answer problem shows up in a few places, like the $3 shelter plant, 'both, job plus side project', 'ask me anything', and the DM to your friend on the rumor card. Those are the answers you pick to look good, not the ones you'd actually do. For someone like me, 27 and already living with my partner, a few love cards read like memories ('what are we?'). The gacha banner is the most me card in the whole thing and it's hidden as a sealed check, so please open chapter 4 with it. The names mostly slap (Human Weighted Blanket, Side-Quest Knight, Needs a save point, Team healer IRL). Just fix the flat ones and the few that brag for the player.
